name: atlassian-twg-cli
description:
Your code lives in your repo. The reasons behind it are spread across Jira work items, Confluence specs, pull requests, incidents, Loom videos and Slack threads.

This plugin installs and configures Teamwork Graph CLI (twg), giving GitHub Copilot one command-line interface to that context. Teamwork Graph maps the work items, docs, PRs, people and decisions across Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jira Service Management, Loom, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive and Salesforce. Copilot runs twg commands, gets structured JSON back, and pulls in only what the task needs.

It can start with a work item, follow it to the linked spec, then the related PR. Because the output is structured JSON, you can also script it, pipe it, or use it in CI. Commands use your Atlassian sign-in, so Copilot can only access what you have permission to see. Run /twg-setup to install twg and sign in, then ask in plain English.
